name: javaCast
description:
Converts the data type of a CFML variable to pass as an
argument to an overloaded method of a Java object. Use only
for scalar and string arguments.
[type - quickly]
boolean,int,long,float,double,string
syntax: javaCast( string type, any variable, [struct javaSettings] )

params.name: type
params.description:
Data type to which to convert variable:
bigdecimal (converts to java.math.BigDecimal)

- boolean
- byte
- char
- int
- long
- float
- double
- short
- string
- {type}[] - where {type} is any of the preceding types, e.g. string[]
- null - see also the built in function nullValue()
- a Java class name

params.name: javaSettings
params.description: javasettings to use to load the class
